title: hrv op computes RMSSD over all detected RR; no ectopy/artifact filtering (confounds age trend)
evidence: autonomic-aging 0554 RMSSD: baseline 315.59 ms -> current raw 224.12 ms -> corrected(reject_invalid) 102.18 ms; corrected-stratum medians young/middle/old 54.2/18.2/89.5 ms (aging_results.csv)
notes: New architecture (classify_intervals + clean_rr_intervals + CorrectionPolicy, exposed via bridge op hrv-correct) gives a user-visible quality/correction path and materially reduces bigeminy inflation. BUT: (1) default remains uncorrected (hrv op unchanged; hrv-correct default policy=none); (2) self-inclusive rolling-median classifier misses sustained periodic ectopy (0554 retains 199/599 NN intervals <550 ms after correction; alternating bigeminy synthetic yields only 1/60 ectopic labels); (3) age trend still non-monotone after correction (old stratum still elevated).

title: CorrectionPolicy::InterpolateCubic executes the linear interpolation code path (no cubic spline)
evidence: cubic_vs_linear.csv: interpolate_cubic output bit-identical to interpolate_linear (max abs diff 0.0 ms) on a crafted series where a true cubic spline differs from linear by up to 17.32 ms; RMSSD identical to 15 digits. Source: src/hrv/quality.rs:157 shared match arm `InterpolateLinear | InterpolateCubic =>` (single linear body).
notes: Documented in SPEC.md Appendix A.3 as a known gap; this wave adds the behavioral falsification evidence. Enum rustdoc ('cubic spline interpolation') and REMEDIATION_PLAN §4.4 overpromise. Not fixed (validation-only).

title: classify_intervals misses sustained periodic ectopy (self-inclusive local median); no percent_threshold band rescues it
evidence: policy_matrix.csv row c_bigeminy: strictly alternating 440/830 ms bigeminy yields 59/60 normal_nn + 1 ectopic_rr (flagged idx 58 is an edge-window artifact); window i-2..i+2 self-inclusive -> 3 same-parity vs 2 opposite -> median = own parity, deviations 0.07-0.30% vs 20% test. Band sweep: p=0.02 catches 11/60 (jit10) while p<=0.01 also flags clean sinus jitter; no separating band. Record 0554: 199/599 retained NN <550 ms (period-3 runs keep median-matching phase normal). Cross-confirmed by Wave A (2/20 flagged; corrected RMSSD 207 vs raw 228 ms).
notes: Root cause: rolling i-2..i+2 median window INCLUDES the interval itself; in a strictly periodic alternating pattern the median equals the interval's own parity class. Isolated ectopy IS caught correctly (series b; embedded couplets 6/6). Fails REMEDIATION_PLAN §4.4 success criterion on bigeminy recordings. Suggest excluding self from the window or adding a global-distribution check.
